_comment: PEMF surum TEK KAYNAGI. Elle burayi degistir, sonra build al. build_tools/sync_versions.ps1 bu degerleri hedef dosyalara yazar; build_installer.ps1 ve build_apk.ps1 basladiginda otomatik cagirir.

_kanallar.backend: PEMF Backend + Inno installer. Hedef: VERSION -> PEMF_Backend_Setup.iss (MyAppVersion) + docs/version_info.txt
_kanallar.launcher: PEMF Vet Client (Tauri). Hedef: launcher/Cargo.toml, launcher/app/tauri.conf.json. Kendi kendini gunceller, git etiketi: launcher-vX.Y.Z
_kanallar.mobile: Android/iOS uygulamasi. Hedef: pf/app.json. androidVersionCode HER YAYINDA ARTMALI (Play Store sarti), geri alinamaz.
_kanallar.frontendOta: Frontend OTA paketi (frontend_dist.zip). Hedef: frontend_version.json. servers/update_manager.py bunu karsilastirir.
